Test Scenario: Verify successful user registration with valid data
Test Steps:
1. Click 'Register' in navbar.
2. Enter valid Name.
3. Enter unique valid Email.
4. Enter valid Password (>=6 chars).
5. Enter matching Confirm Password.
6. Click 'Create Account'.
Test Data: Name: Sarah Connor, Email: sarah.c@example.com, Pass: Secret123!, Confirm: Secret123!
Expected Result: Account created successfully, modal closes, user greeting displayed in navbar, success toast appears.
Actual Result: Account created successfully, user greeted in navbar as 'Hi, Sarah Connor'.

Test Scenario: Verify registration with existing/duplicate email address
Test Steps:
1. Open registration modal.
2. Enter Name.
3. Enter existing Email 'testuser@example.com'.
4. Enter Password and Confirm Password.
5. Click 'Create Account'.
Expected Result: Registration rejected with alert message 'An account with this email already exists.'
Actual Result: Alert message displayed: 'An account with this email already exists.' Registration prevented.
Remarks: Negative test case for duplicate prevention.

Test Scenario: Verify registration validation when passwords do not match
Test Steps:
1. Fill Name and Email.
2. Enter Password 'Password123!'.
3. Enter Confirm Password 'Mismatch456!'.
4. Click 'Create Account'.
Expected Result: Inline error 'Passwords do not match' displayed under Confirm Password field.
Actual Result: Inline error 'Passwords do not match' displayed; submission blocked.

Test Scenario: Verify registration password boundary value (less than 6 characters)
Test Steps:
1. Fill Name and Email.
2. Enter 5-character Password '12345'.
3. Enter Confirm Password '12345'.
4. Click 'Create Account'.
Expected Result: Inline error 'Password must be at least 6 characters' displayed.
Actual Result: Inline error 'Password must be at least 6 characters' displayed; submission blocked.

Test Scenario: Verify registration form submission with all fields empty
Test Steps:
1. Leave all fields empty.
2. Click 'Create Account' button.
Expected Result: Validation error messages displayed under all required fields.
Actual Result: Validation messages 'Full name is required', 'Email address is required', 'Password is required' displayed.

Test Scenario: Verify login with valid registered credentials
Preconditions: Default test user exists; user is logged out
Test Steps:
1. Click 'Login' in navbar.
2. Enter registered Email.
3. Enter correct Password.
4. Click 'Login' button.
Expected Result: User logs in successfully, modal closes, navbar displays 'Hi, Test User' and Logout button.
Actual Result: User logged in, avatar and greeting 'Hi, Test User' visible in navbar.

Test Scenario: Verify login failure with incorrect password
Test Steps:
1. Enter valid Email.
2. Enter incorrect Password.
3. Click 'Login' button.
Expected Result: Login rejected; alert message 'Invalid credentials: Incorrect password.' displayed.
Actual Result: Alert message 'Invalid credentials: Incorrect password.' displayed.

Test Scenario: Verify login failure with unregistered email address
Test Steps:
1. Enter unregistered Email.
2. Enter any Password.
3. Click 'Login' button.
Expected Result: Login rejected; alert message 'Invalid credentials: User does not exist.' displayed.
Actual Result: Alert message 'Invalid credentials: User does not exist.' displayed.

Test Scenario: Verify login form validation with empty email and password
Test Steps:
1. Leave email and password inputs blank.
2. Click 'Login' button.
Expected Result: Validation errors 'Email address is required' and 'Password is required' displayed.
Actual Result: Inline error messages displayed under both fields; form not submitted.

Test Scenario: Verify user logout functionality and session termination
Test Steps:
1. Click 'Logout' button in navbar.
2. Verify navbar returns to Guest state.
Expected Result: Session cleared, navbar shows 'Login' and 'Register' buttons, toast confirms logout.
Actual Result: Session cleared, navbar toggled to guest mode, toast notification displayed.

Test Scenario: Verify product catalog displays all available items on initial page load
Test Steps:
1. Observe main catalog grid.
2. Verify total product count indicator.
Expected Result: Catalog displays 12 product cards with message 'Showing 12 of 12 products'.
Actual Result: All 12 product cards rendered cleanly; count message indicates 'Showing 12 of 12 products'.

Test Scenario: Verify all product cards render image, category, title, rating, and price correctly
Test Steps:
1. Inspect each product card in the grid.
2. Verify presence of image, category badge, title, star rating, reviews count, price, Details and Add to Cart buttons.
Expected Result: All card components are visible and correctly formatted with currency symbol.
Actual Result: Components rendered as expected with price formatted as '$199.99' and category badge.

Test Scenario: Verify opening product details modal by clicking 'Details' button
Test Steps:
1. Locate product #1 (Quantum Pro Wireless Headphones).
2. Click 'Details' button.
Expected Result: Modal opens displaying high-res product visual, title, price, in-depth description, rating, stock status, and quantity selector.
Actual Result: Modal displayed with correct product title, price '$199.99', stock '(25 units available)', and description.

Test Scenario: Verify quantity adjustment inside product details modal
Test Steps:
1. Click '+' button to increment quantity to 3.
2. Click '-' button to decrement to 2.
3. Verify quantity input updates.
Expected Result: Quantity updates dynamically between 1 and available stock limit.
Actual Result: Quantity incremented to 3 and decremented to 2 as expected.

Test Scenario: Verify closing product details modal via close button and backdrop click
Test Steps:
1. Click '×' close button on top right of modal.
2. Reopen modal and click outside modal card on backdrop.
Expected Result: Modal closes and returns user to the catalog view.
Actual Result: Modal closes smoothly on both actions.

Test Scenario: Verify searching for an existing product by exact title keyword
Test Steps:
1. Enter 'Laptop' into search bar.
2. Click search icon or press Enter.
Expected Result: Grid updates to display only matching laptop products; count indicates 'Showing 1 of 12 products'.
Actual Result: UltraBook Pro laptop displayed; count shows 'Showing 1 of 12 products'.

Test Scenario: Verify search is case-insensitive (uppercase and lowercase)
Test Steps:
1. Search for 'HEADPHONES'.
2. Note results.
3. Search for 'headphones'.
Expected Result: Both queries return identical result: 'Quantum Pro Wireless Headphones'.
Actual Result: Both searches returned the exact same product card.

Test Scenario: Verify searching for a non-existing product displays empty state message
Test Steps:
1. Enter non-existent keyword 'Spaceship'.
2. Click search button.
Expected Result: Grid displays empty state message 'No matching products found' with 'Clear Filters' button.
Actual Result: Empty state with message 'No matching products found' displayed.

Test Scenario: Verify search behavior with leading/trailing whitespace without trim
Test Steps:
1. Enter query with spaces: '  Camera  '.
2. Press Enter to search.
3. Observe search results.
Expected Result: Leading/trailing whitespace should be trimmed, showing '4K Action Sports Camera'.
Actual Result: Search query was not trimmed before filtering, causing 0 products to match due to space mismatch.
Remarks: Defect logged as BUG-003: Search query does not trim whitespace.

Test Scenario: Verify clearing search input restores full product catalog
Test Steps:
1. Click '×' clear button in search input.
2. Verify catalog restores.
Expected Result: Search input is cleared and all 12 products are displayed again.
Actual Result: Search cleared; catalog restored to 12 products.

Test Scenario: Verify filtering products by 'Electronics' category
Preconditions: Catalog is loaded with All Categories selected
Test Steps:
1. In sidebar, select 'Electronics' radio button.
2. Verify filtered items.
Expected Result: Only Electronics products (Headphones, Laptop, Smartwatch, Camera) displayed (4 items).
Actual Result: 4 electronics products displayed; count shows 'Showing 4 of 12 products'.

Test Scenario: Verify filtering products by 'Apparel' category
Test Steps: 1. Select 'Apparel' radio button.
Expected Result: Only Apparel items (T-Shirt, Jeans, Fleece Jacket) displayed (3 items).
Actual Result: 3 apparel items displayed correctly.

Test Scenario: Verify filtering products by maximum price slider threshold
Test Steps:
1. Move price range slider to $50.
2. Verify products displayed.
Expected Result: Only products priced <= $50 (T-Shirt $24.99, Clean Code $39.99, Selenium Guide $44.50) displayed.
Actual Result: Exactly 3 products under $50 displayed; count shows 'Showing 3 of 12 products'.

Test Scenario: Verify combining category filter and price range filter simultaneously
Test Steps:
1. Select category 'Home & Kitchen'.
2. Set price slider to $100.
Expected Result: Only Home & Kitchen items with price <= $100 (Dutch Oven $69.95) displayed.
Actual Result: Only Cast Iron Dutch Oven ($69.95) displayed.

Test Scenario: Verify 'Reset All' button clears all category, price, and search filters
Test Steps: 1. Click 'Reset All' button in sidebar filter header.
Expected Result: Category resets to 'All Categories', price slider resets to $1500, search cleared, 12 items displayed.
Actual Result: All filters reset to defaults and all 12 items displayed.

Test Scenario: Verify sorting products by Price: Low to High
Test Steps:
1. Open 'Sort by' dropdown.
2. Select 'Price: Low to High'.
3. Verify order of items.
Expected Result: Products ordered ascending by price (starting at $24.99 T-Shirt up to $1099.99 Laptop).
Actual Result: First product is $24.99 and last product is $1099.99.

Test Scenario: Verify sorting products by Customer Rating
Test Steps: 1. Select 'Customer Rating' from sort dropdown.
Expected Result: Products ordered descending by rating (top rating 4.9 first).
Actual Result: Products with 4.9 rating (UltraBook, Clean Code) appear first.

Test Scenario: Verify adding a product to cart from product card in catalog
Test Steps:
1. Click 'Add to Cart' on product #1 (Quantum Pro).
2. Observe cart badge and toast notification.
Expected Result: Cart badge updates to '1', toast notification 'Added "Quantum Pro..." to cart!' appears.
Actual Result: Cart badge incremented to 1; confirmation toast displayed.

Test Scenario: Verify adding multiple quantities of a product from details modal
Test Steps:
1. Open details for product #5 (T-Shirt).
2. Set quantity to 3.
3. Click 'Add to Cart'.
Expected Result: Cart badge updates by 3 (total badge = 4).
Actual Result: Cart badge updated to 4; toast displayed.

Test Scenario: Verify cart drawer displays all added items, quantities, and correct subtotal
Test Steps:
1. Click cart icon button in navbar.
2. Verify list of items, item subtotals, tax, and order total.
Actual Result: Subtotal, tax, and total matched calculations exactly.

Test Scenario: Verify incrementing item quantity using '+' button in cart drawer
Test Steps:
1. Click '+' button next to product #1.
2. Observe quantity and totals.
Expected Result: Quantity updates to 2, item subtotal updates to $399.98, cart badge increments to 5.
Actual Result: Quantity updated to 2; subtotals recalculated automatically.

Test Scenario: Verify decrementing item quantity using '-' button down to 1
Test Steps: 1. Click '-' button next to product #1.
Expected Result: Quantity updates to 1, totals decrease accordingly.
Actual Result: Quantity decreased to 1 and totals updated.

Test Scenario: Verify manual input of negative or zero quantity in cart quantity field
Test Steps:
1. In cart drawer, click into quantity input for an item.
2. Type '-2' or '0' and click away (blur event).
3. Observe cart calculation.
Expected Result: System should reject negative/zero input, display error or clamp to minimum 1.
Actual Result: System accepts negative value '-2', producing negative subtotal and corrupting cart total.
Remarks: Defect logged as BUG-001: Cart accepts negative quantity on direct input.

Test Scenario: Verify removing a single product item from cart drawer
Test Steps:
1. Click 'Remove' button under product #5.
2. Verify item removed and totals updated.
Expected Result: Product #5 removed from list, cart count decrements, total updates.
Actual Result: Item removed from cart; totals and badge updated.

Test Scenario: Verify clearing the entire cart using 'Clear Cart' button
Test Steps:
1. Click 'Clear Cart' button in cart drawer.
2. Observe cart state.
Expected Result: Cart empties, displays 'Your shopping cart is empty', badge resets to 0, Proceed to Checkout button is disabled.
Actual Result: Cart emptied; empty state displayed; badge = 0; checkout disabled.

Test Scenario: Verify 'Proceed to Checkout' button opens checkout modal with pre-filled totals
Test Steps:
1. Open cart drawer.
2. Click 'Proceed to Checkout'.
Expected Result: Cart drawer closes, Checkout modal opens, Total Payable displays correct cart total.
Actual Result: Checkout modal opened displaying correct Total Payable amount.

Test Scenario: Verify checkout form validation when submitting with all fields empty
Test Steps:
1. Leave all shipping inputs empty.
2. Click 'Place Order' button.
Expected Result: Validation error messages appear under all required fields (Name, Email, Address, City, State, ZIP, Card fields).
Actual Result: Inline error messages appeared under required fields; submission stopped.

Test Scenario: Verify email field validation with invalid email format in checkout
Test Steps:
1. Enter 'invalid-email-address' into Email field.
2. Fill other fields.
3. Click 'Place Order'.
Expected Result: Field validation error 'Enter a valid email address' displayed.
Actual Result: Validation message 'Enter a valid email address' displayed; submission blocked.

Test Scenario: Verify ZIP code field format validation when entering alphabetic characters
Test Steps:
1. Fill all valid details.
2. In ZIP / Postal Code field, enter letters: 'ABCDE'.
3. Click 'Place Order'.
Expected Result: Field should validate numerical ZIP postal code format (e.g. 5 digits) and reject alphabetic string.
Actual Result: Form accepts 'ABCDE' as valid ZIP because it only verifies non-empty without regex format validation.
Remarks: Defect logged as BUG-002: ZIP code accepts non-numeric input without format check.

Test Scenario: Verify toggling payment method between Credit Card and Cash on Delivery
Test Steps:
1. Select 'Cash on Delivery' radio option.
2. Observe card details section.
3. Re-select 'Credit / Debit Card'.
Expected Result: When COD selected, card inputs (card number, exp, cvv) are hidden; when Card selected, they reappear.
Actual Result: Card input fields toggled visibility cleanly.

Test Scenario: Verify credit card fields validation (card length, expiry, cvv)
Test Steps:
1. Enter short card number '123'.
2. Enter CVV '1'.
3. Click 'Place Order'.
Expected Result: Validation errors 'Card number format is incomplete' and 'CVV format is incomplete' displayed.
Actual Result: Validation errors displayed under card number and CVV; order prevented.

Test Scenario: Verify successful order placement with complete valid checkout data
Preconditions: Cart contains items; checkout modal open
Test Steps:
1. Fill Name: 'John Doe', Email: 'john@example.com', Address: '123 Test Way', City: 'Boston', State: 'MA', ZIP: '02115'.
2. Select COD or valid mock card.
3. Click 'Place Order'.
Expected Result: Checkout modal closes, Order Confirmation modal opens with unique Order ID (e.g. 'ORD-XXXXXX'), summary of ordered items, total paid, and recipient info.
Actual Result: Order confirmed, unique Order ID generated, correct summary and recipient info displayed.

Test Scenario: Verify shopping cart is automatically cleared upon successful order placement
Test Steps:
1. Inspect cart badge.
2. Open cart drawer.
Expected Result: Cart badge is 0, cart drawer shows empty state, localStorage cart is cleared.
Actual Result: Cart badge reset to 0, drawer shows empty state.

Test Scenario: Verify 'Continue Shopping' button resets UI and allows new purchases
Test Steps:
1. Click 'Continue Shopping' button.
2. Verify confirmation modal closes and user can browse catalog again.
Expected Result: Modal closes, catalog displays with all products ready for browsing.
Actual Result: Modal closed cleanly, catalog ready for fresh purchases.
